mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail and a New Moon tonight. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 37 degrees, with no rain expected.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, focusing on utility upgrades and new sidewalk infrastructure. Additionally, the Parks and Recreation department continues to update standings for various local men's, women's, and coed sports leagues.

Today, you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of options, including trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.

In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after he was discovered passed out in his vehicle.
Today's Flavor of the Day is the wonderful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and serving until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
